_comment: Token prices per model, read by src/usage.py. Deliberately EMPTY on arrival.
Prices change and differ per account, so none is shipped as a guess: a model with
no entry here reports its real token counts and a null cost carrying the reason,
which is honest. A wrong price would be worse than no price, because it would be
quoted with the same confidence as a measured one.
To price a run, add the model id exactly as it appears in the scorecard and fill
in the rates from your provider's own pricing page:
Locally served models are free to run and are priced at zero on purpose, so a
cloud-versus-local comparison shows tokens on both sides rather than a blank.
